Chrome DevTools update: We are shipping "scopes" proposal support behind an experimental flag now. If you use Chrome Canary version  157.0.8079.0 or newer, you can give it a spin. Enable the feature either via chrome://flags or DevTools > Settings > Experiments.

I let Gemini build some small examples to play with it: https://szuend.github.io/source-map-scopes-examples/

What should work:
* Scopes view in the sidebar
* Stack traces (excluding outlining for now)
* Inline hints in the editor
* Hovering over variables / expressions
* Using original variables names when evaluating expressions in the console (while paused)
